Maria C.: Quick heads-up — Eris Health go-live with Dedicated pool is scheduled TOM at 09:00 PT. Need final sign-off on quota, autoscale bands, and the dry-run load test window.
Alex P.: thanks — can we confirm requested GPU quota and burst? I have a tentative ask of 8xA100 steady, burst to 12 for 15m.
Kevin L.: 8 steady + 12 burst sounds right given their usage profile. What target QPS (chat requests)?
Maria C.: they expect 350 concurrent chat sessions, ~20 tokens/sec average per session. Plan assumes batching + prefix cache so throughput = ~1400 tokens/s.
Samira R.: for autoscale, propose policy: scale-up at 70% util, scale-down at 30%, cool-down 3m, max replicas = 15. That maps to the burst cap.
Ryan (CS): +1 on those thresholds. We should set a warmup priming job to avoid cold KV misses during cutover. Who owns priming?
Alex P.: I'll run the priming script pre-cutover (T-20m). Will push prefix cache for top 50 prompts per customer.
Maria C.: great. Load test plan: 09:10-09:25 PT smoke (10m ramp), 09:30-09:50 PT full soak (20m). Can we keep monitoring alerted to latency p50/p95 and token cost?
Kevin L.: yes. I'll add dashboards and alerts. Alert if p95 > 600ms for >2min or error rate >1%.
Samira R.: also add an autoscale fallback policy to route to fallback model if capacity stalls. We should configure automatic rollback if error spike persists >5m.
Maria C.: noted. Who will run the load test? Ryan? Alex?
Ryan (CS): I can run the orchestrated load test from my laptop and hand off to Alex for priming. I'll use the load harness in infra repo.
Alex P.: command I'll run for soak (local dev):
```
./tools/loadtest --team eris --rps 120 --duration 1200 --model redwood/v1-dedicated --prefill-cache --verbose
```
Alex P.: will also track kv-cache hit rate and token counts.
deploy-bot: Reserved pool creation completed for customer=eris-health pool_id=rp-87ff9d status=ready
onboard-bot: Playbook link added: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/dedicated/eris-go-live (contains rollback steps, contact list)
Maria C.: Checklist recap: 1) quota confirmed (8 steady / 12 burst) 2) autoscale policy (70/30/3m/15) 3) priming script T-20m (Alex) 4) smoke + soak windows (09:10/09:30) 5) dashboards & alerts (Kevin) 6) fallback routing (Samira) 7) load test run (Ryan) 8) playbook validated. Anyone blocking?
Kevin L.: No blockers from infra. I'll attach the dashboard links after 08:00 PT tomorrow.
Samira R.: I'll validate fallback config in staging tonight and post results here.
Alex P.: I'll run priming dry-run now against staging to confirm script idempotency.
Ryan (CS): I'll schedule a 15m Ops bridge for 08:50 PT. Invite sent to #oncall and engineering leads.
Maria C.: perfect. If nothing else, I'll mark this thread as the central coordination channel. Ping here with any surprises. :thumbsup:
Alex P.: one more note — we'll collect sample traces and keep token-level cost metrics exported for product to review post-run.
Maria C.: thanks all. See you tomorrow.
